description: This is a Java source file defining MainActivity for an Android Wearable app that manages a delayed confirmation timer, communicates with other devices via GoogleApiClient and Wearable APIs, and handles user interactions with a delayed confirmation view.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity managing delayed confirmation and device communication in a wearable application.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up GoogleApiClient and UI components.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Connects the GoogleApiClient if not already connected.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Disconnects GoogleApiClient and removes capability listener.

methods.name: onStartTimer
methods.description: Starts the delayed confirmation timer UI and sets its listener.

methods.name: onTimerSelected
methods.description: Handles the event when the timer is selected, shows notification, and sends a message.

methods.name: onTimerFinished
methods.description: Handles timer completion, shows notification, and sends a message.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles failure to connect to GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: sendMessageToCompanion
methods.description: Sends a message via Wearable API to the connected device.

methods.name: getSendMessageResultCallback
methods.description: Returns a callback to handle send message result.

methods.name: setupConfirmationHandlerNode
methods.description: Sets up node capability listener and retrieves available nodes.

methods.name: updateConfirmationCapability
methods.description: Updates the preferred confirmation handler node based on capabilities.

methods.name: pickBestNode
methods.description: Selects the best node, preferring nearby nodes.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback when GoogleApiClient connects, triggers capability setup.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Callback when GoogleApiClient connection is suspended.

methods.name: onCapabilityChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to the device's capability info.
